description: The plot illustrates the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" for four different model and dataset combinations across four discrete x-axis values. The x-axis lacks an explicit label and displays discrete tick marks at values of 128, 256, 512, and 1024, which are spaced at roughly equal visual intervals. The y-axis is labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The blue solid line with circle markers represents "LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep"; it begins at approximately 0.20 at x=128, rises to roughly 0.25 at x=256, increases to about 0.35 at x=512, and ends with a slight increase to approximately 0.36 at x=1024. The orange solid line with square markers denotes "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep," starting at roughly 0.15 at x=128, increasing to about 0.23 at x=256, rising sharply to approximately 0.42 at x=512, and remaining steady to end at 0.42 at x=1024. The green solid line with triangle markers indicates "LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench," which starts at approximately 0.07 at x=128, climbs sharply to about 0.21 at x=256, continues to rise to roughly 0.37 at x=512, and finishes at approximately 0.38 at x=1024. Finally, the red solid line with diamond markers represents "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench"; it begins at approximately 0.24 at x=128, increases to about 0.27 at x=256, rises to roughly 0.42 at x=512, and continues to climb, reaching the highest overall value of approximately 0.51 at x=1024.
